fact: The paper, using Births and Deaths Registry data for March to October 2023 and 2024, studies births registered on the digital platform at the two registry centres of Ablekuma West Municipal Assembly (Dansoman and Gbegbeyise), states that the digital registration platform was already in existence when the Ghana Card Number at Birth system was integrated on 14 March 2024, and reports 1,722 births registered there in March to October 2024 against 2,310 a year earlier, linking the fall to infrastructure and system failures and insufficient staff training.
title: The Effect of Digital Systems Integration on Birth Registration Rates: A Demographic Study in Ablekuma West, Ghana
